_comment: Career stints Wikipedia lists that the player never actually played.
The daily pipeline rebuilds career_history from the article on every
run, so deleting a stint by hand lasts exactly until the next run. Each
removal is recorded here instead and re-applied after every parse, the
same way data/teams/stint_start_dates.json re-stamps known signing dates.
Matching is on player + team + start year, so a span that later changes
shape ('2001' -> '2001-2002') still matches. Written and applied by

removals.reason: Signed a contract with Partizan in 2001 but left for the Utah Jazz before playing a game for them.
